Drop IHUI_YOLO and retry so that you confirm each command.

cliEntry.tagline: IHUI AI Coding Agent — a coding agent benchmarked against Claude Code / Codex
cliEntry.maxTurnsDesc: Maximum tool-loop iterations (alias of --max-iterations, aligned with OpenAI o1/o3 terminology)
cliEntry.apiUrlDesc: Backend API URL (read from settings.json by default, falls back to http://localhost:8802)
cliEntry.jsonDesc: Headless mode: emit an NDJSON event stream (auto-enabled when not a TTY, CI/CD friendly)
cliEntry.outputFormatDesc: P1-5 Headless output format: text|json|markdown|yaml (overrides --json, default text)
cliEntry.allowDangerousDesc: Let dangerous tools (run_command/delete_file/git_commit) run without confirmation (denied by default; REPL mode asks interactively)
cliEntry.permissionLeaseDesc: Permission lease: explicitly name the tools whose per-call approval is relaxed for THIS run only (comma-separated, e.g. write_file,git_commit). Omitting it grants nothing and keeps behavior identical to before
cliEntry.permissionLeaseTtlDesc: Permission lease duration in minutes (default 10, capped at 60; whichever comes first, duration or turns, wins)
cliEntry.permissionLeaseTurnsDesc: Permission lease turn limit (default 1, capped at 25; whichever comes first, duration or turns, wins)
cliEntry.permissionLeaseGranted: ℹ Permission lease granted: {tools} (for {ttl} minutes / {turns} turns, expires {expiresAt})
cliEntry.permissionLeaseDigestDesc: Enable content binding (this is a tightening, not a relaxation): tools in the list stay locked until they receive one real approval, and afterwards any change to the call content invalidates that approval and asks again. Must be used together with --permission-lease. To turn it off: drop this flag, or set IHUI_LEASE_SLOT_DIGEST=0
cliEntry.permissionLeaseDigestGranted: ℹ Content binding is on (a tightening, not a relaxation): the first approval for a listed tool is bound to its call content; when the content changes the old approval no longer applies and you will be asked again. Effective duration and turns are on the line above. To turn it off, remove --permission-lease-digest or set IHUI_LEASE_SLOT_DIGEST=0
cliEntry.permissionLeaseInvalid: Permission lease could not be granted; this run was aborted: {reason}
cliEntry.replLeaseDesc: Grant/view/revoke a time-boxed permission lease interactively (named tools skip per-call approvals, bounded by time and turns)
cliEntry.replLeaseGranted: ✅ Permission lease granted: {tools} ({ttl} min / {turns} turns, expires {expiresAt}, audit ref {auditRef})
cliEntry.replLeaseNone: No permission lease granted (default mode): wide-permission actions still ask for approval each time
cliEntry.replLeaseActive: Permission lease active: scope={scope} capabilities={tools} remaining {remainingSeconds}s, turns {turnsUsed}/{turnsTotal}, expires {expiresAt}, audit ref {auditRef}
cliEntry.replLeaseDigestGranted: ℹ Content binding is on (a tightening, not a relaxation): the first approval for the tools above is bound to their call content; when the content changes the old approval no longer applies and you will be asked again. To turn it off: remove --digest, or set IHUI_LEASE_SLOT_DIGEST=0
cliEntry.replLeaseDigestStateOn: Content binding: on ({slots} slot(s) already bound; tools not yet bound will still be asked until their first approval)
cliEntry.replLeaseDigestStateOff: Content binding: off (capabilities are relaxed by tool name alone and are not pinned to call content)
cliEntry.replLeaseExpired: Permission lease no longer live (expired or turns used up): audit ref {auditRef}
cliEntry.replLeaseRevoked: Permission lease revoked immediately: audit ref {auditRef} (back to default mode afterwards)
cliEntry.replLeaseNothingToRevoke: There is no permission lease to revoke (default mode, nothing to undo)
cliEntry.replLeaseInvalid: ✗ Permission lease not granted; current state unchanged: {reason}
